result.title: PDE-State Conditioning for Learned Optimization Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
result.summary: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) optimization depends on global properties of the underlying PDE and how the physics residual evolves across the domain. Standard optimizers such as Adam use fixed gradient-based statistics, while learned PINN optimizers replace the fixed rule with a learned update built from local parameters and optimization-history features. However, none explicitly use PDE-level information. We study two coupled design questions: what PDE-level information should a learned optimizer observe, and how should that information influence its update? We introduce an 11-dimensional PDE state-capturing operator structure, residual geometry, and short-horizon update response, and use it to condition a structured meta-learned optimizer through bounded feature-wise modulation. Repeated design studies identify the compact residual-geometry state G2 and bounded FiLM as the strongest overall choices among those tested. The resulting PDE-State-conditioned optimizer improves all evaluation metrics (relative-L2, L1, solution MSE, and physics MSE) over Adam and the unconditioned learned optimizer on Linear Advection, KdV, and Burgers.

AI.brief_summary: 该文研究学习式 PINN 优化器应观测哪些 PDE 层级信息以及如何据此调节更新，构造 11 维状态描述（算子结构、残差几何、短期更新响应），并通过有界 FiLM 调制元学习优化器；设计比较显示紧凑残差几何状态 G2 加有界 FiLM 最优，在多个 PDE 上优于 Adam 与无条件学习优化器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「紧凑状态摘要 + 有界特征级调制」及对状态内容的设计对比，可能可供核查 LVR 中由内部状态筛选与调节 latent 更新这一问题；但属科学计算优化领域，与视觉推理仅有间接方法线索。
